name: Glock Boyz TMC
description: Glock Boyz TMC (Too Much Cash) is a violent street gang operating on the west side of Detroit. Members have been federally prosecuted for firearms offenses, identity theft, and wire fraud.

sources.title: Glock Boyz Gang Member Sentenced to 60 Months in Prison for Aggravated Identity Theft and Wire Fraud | USAO-EDMI | Department of Justice
